# Your Skill Name

## Purpose

Describe the job of the skill, expected outcomes, and when this skill is the correct fit.

Include a short "When this does not fit" note to prevent accidental misuse.

If the skill depends on extra documents, point to references/ here.

---

## Workflow

Describe the skill workflow as explicit phases or steps.

Use numbered lists for strict sequence and bullet lists for optional checks.

---

## Input Handling

State required inputs, optional inputs, and fallback behavior when inputs are missing.

---

## Output Contract

Define what output shape the user should receive.

Include formatting requirements, minimum sections, and quality checks.

---

## Proportionality

Explain how rigor scales by task size and risk.

At minimum, define a lightweight path for trivial work and a full path for high-risk work.

---

## Changelog

Maintained by Kurt Mitchell.

Versioning uses MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH.

The top entry in this section must match metadata.version.
